step_by_step_reasoning: The Media Analysis Solution on AWS automatically processes and extracts metadata from media files (video, audio, or images) uploaded to Amazon S3. An S3 bucket notification triggers an AWS Lambda function, which starts an AWS Step Functions state machine. Step Functions orchestrates processing across multiple parallel branches: a Custom ML Model branch (represented via SageMaker) that indexes custom model metadata into Elasticsearch (OpenSearch); an Amazon Rekognition branch for visual analysis (object, face, and scene detection) that sends metadata to Elasticsearch; and an audio processing branch starting with AWS Elemental MediaConvert, which extracts audio tracks from videos to bypass size limits before passing the audio to Amazon Transcribe. Amazon Transcribe converts speech to text, writing transcription metadata directly to Elasticsearch while also feeding the text into Amazon Comprehend for natural language processing (entity extraction and sentiment analysis), which then outputs sentiment and entity metadata to Elasticsearch.
